== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Reversal of Damage]], when the 50% chance property triggers, the damage inflicted to the target of the foe hexed with Calculated Risk is always reduced to 0 even when the damage inflicted was more than the stated maximum.
* Only attacks that [[hit]] can trigger this hex's effects; effects that cause [[miss]] or [[block]] will result in fewer attacks backfiring.
